samples.title: Petrol up, fares up - that is economics
samples.subject: Economics
samples.script: Month-end at the taxi rank. Petrol price goes up, and by Monday the fare is two rand more. Fewer people take the taxi for short trips - they walk. You just watched demand with your own eyes. Price up, quantity demanded down. No graph yet - first feel it. The gogo buying six loaves when bread is on special? Price down, quantity up. Now we draw the picture: price up the side, amount along the bottom, and the line slides down like a taxi rolling downhill.
